subject: [PATCH 43/60] mm/page_alloc: fall back when a bind policy's nodes become private

2026-11-20.patch_summary: The patch addresses a memory hotplug issue where a bind policy's nodes become private, causing allocation failures due to the nodemask intersecting with the cpuset. It relaxes the private request by dropping the nodemask and allocating from common memory when no node in the zonelist is available.
